log_level.description: Verbosity of logging. Choose from: debug, info, warning, error, critical.

max_transfers.description: Maximum number of concurrent media transfers (playback, streaming, etc.).

dbus_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for D-Bus operations before failing.

verbose.description: Enable extra verbose logging to the systemd journal. Increases I/O and log volume.

interfaces.description: List of network interfaces (e.g., ['eth0', 'wlan0']) to bind to. Leave empty to use all interfaces.

supported_protocols.description: UPnP AV protocol prefixes and optional MIME types the renderer supports.

mime_type.description: MIME type filter (e.g., 'video/*', 'audio/*') or '*' for any.

enable_external.description: Enable discovery and support for external or remote DLNA renderers via SSDP/GSSDP.

friendly_name.description: Human-readable name shown in DLNA control points (e.g., 'Living Room Speaker'). If empty, hostname is used.

location_url.description: Base URL where this renderer exposes web UI or control endpoints (e.g., 'http://192.168.1.10:9790'). Optional.
